startup_read_status.home_latest_continuity_gearbox: TARGETED_LOOKUP_NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_EXACT_PATH; Home#73 retained only through fresh Active-8 pointer; NO_BROAD_ARCHIVE_READ

agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review mutates neither formal state nor candidate code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only in the v2.1 semantic boundary; repetition cannot promote them to verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and should remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Strict bool intake is present for v2 authority-sensitive booleans and v2.1 secretary/authority flags; those type-coercion defects are not current findings.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commits, wakes, heartbeats or awake time are invalid substitutes.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events accepts an arbitrary Iterable with no maximum record budget, time budget, streaming cursor or bounded seen-set policy. A very large or non-terminating iterable can consume unbounded CPU/time and grow the per-call seen set until the review/runtime path stalls. This is distinct from replay-credit inflation: even unique, syntactically valid IDs can exhaust ingestion resources and bias latency/availability measurements.
disagreements.required_change: Add a versioned bounded ingestion contract: precommitted maximum records and/or monotonic processing budget per batch, deterministic continuation cursor, explicit BATCH_LIMIT_REACHED outcome, and bounded memory semantics. Never silently drop accepted evidence; overflow must be resumable and auditable. Thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 parses recent_shift_rate_ratio and verified_progress_density before inherited v2 can produce authenticated rollback R or standby N, so malformed/out-of-range nonessential telemetry can suppress terminal safety evaluation.
disagreements.required_change: Terminal/safety authority must precede nonessential telemetry parsing, or telemetry must arrive through a separately validated trusted envelope whose failure cannot suppress authenticated R/N.

disagreements.finding: Freshness logic neutralizes secretary_level only; routing-relevant numeric pressure fields remain unbound to per-field source/freshness, so stale secretary-derived telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind every routing telemetry component to typed source/freshness/scope/policy provenance and exclude stale/conflicting secretary-derived components individually.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified before determining whether the event kind requires verifier semantics, so irrelevant malformed verifier metadata can abort a batch and censor later valid evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Canonicalize EventKind first; only verified classes enter verifier parsing, and irrelevant malformed verifier metadata must be bounded to that record.

disagreements.finding: Verified-class events with independently_verified=false receive zero credit but disappear from outcome accounting because there is no rejected_unverified outcome.
disagreements.required_change: Use exhaustive conserved outcomes: accepted_verified, accepted_operational, rejected_unverified, duplicate, identity_conflict and ignored_malformed.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source, freshness, scope and policy metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: v2 can deny real Experience outside canonical C_VERIFIED while v2.1 independently recomputes positive verified_experience_delta from raw caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 consumes immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt or exact inherited eligibility; it must not re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational progress is granted from caller-supplied event_id/event_kind without durable artifact or defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Unbounded event batches can cause memory/time exhaustion, make availability dependent on caller batch size, and bias cycle/recovery latency measurements even without duplicate-credit inflation.
Malformed anti-thrash/progress telemetry can censor trusted terminal rollback/standby before terminal authority is evaluated.
Stale secretary telemetry can leak through unbound numeric pressure components even when secretary_level itself is ignored.
Irrelevant verifier-field parsing can create batch-order denial-of-evidence and censor later valid observations.
Unverified verified-class claims disappear from current ledger quality denominators.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-LEDGER-BATCH-LIMIT-153: feed a finite batch just below, at and above the precommitted record budget; over-budget records must produce deterministic resumable BATCH_LIMIT_REACHED without losing or double-crediting accepted evidence.

GB21-LEDGER-NONTERMINATING-ITERABLE-154: an unbounded generator must not hang the ingestion path indefinitely; processing stops at the trusted budget and emits a continuation cursor with zero silent loss.
GB21-LEDGER-BUDGET-REPLAY-155: resume an overflowed batch repeatedly; exact accepted records remain NO_OP and continuation cannot inflate verified or operational credit.
Secretary freshness forge and exact AuthorityDecisionEnvelope projection tests remain required.
Shift-rate provenance, small-n, anti-thrash chatter/release and paired performance non-regression tests remain required.
Cross-run replay, rollback replay, same-evidence/new-ID lineage and same-ID/different-binding conflict tests remain required.
Verified evidence without exact trusted verifier/C receipt must yield zero authoritative verified credit.
Operational progress without durable artifact/defect receipt must yield zero authoritative operational credit.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency under sealed matched workloads and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: claim that Experience ledger ingestion is availability-bounded while event batch size/time/memory are unbounded
claim that rollback/standby terminal authority is structurally protected while nonessential telemetry can abort before inherited terminal evaluation
claim that stale secretary signals have zero routing effect until every routing-relevant secretary-derived field is freshness/provenance bound
claim that authority precedence is executable until exact fresh AuthorityDecisionEnvelope projection exists
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
automatic authority escalation based on secretary/anti-thrash/progress heuristics
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.
Experience ledger ingestion has a precommitted bounded record/time/memory budget with deterministic resumable continuation and replay-safe accounting; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Trusted rollback/standby terminal authority cannot be suppressed by malformed or out-of-range nonessential anti-thrash/progress telemetry; terminal precedence has explicit executable tests.

Every routing-relevant secretary-derived telemetry field is bound to source/freshness/scope/policy; stale or authority-conflicting secretary-derived pressure is excluded while independent fresh runtime telemetry remains usable.
Event kind is canonically classified before verifier parsing; only verified classes parse verifier evidence, and irrelevant malformed verifier metadata cannot censor later independent records.
Ledger outcome accounting is exhaustive and conserved, including rejected_unverified.
Every authoritative verified delta comes only from immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt bound to exact evidence and trusted verifier identity.
Operational progress remains operational-only and authoritative numerator credit requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipts with lineage dedupe.
Duplicate/exact replay is resolved by durable identity/binding; exact replay is NO_OP and same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
secretary freshness is source/TTL/scope/policy bound and authority conflict projects exact fresh AuthorityDecisionEnvelope.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is internally derived from canonical shift history with precommitted sample/window/uncertainty and stateful hysteresis; anti-thrash passes paired performance non-regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wait/scheduler wake/window age/uptime remain zero Experience; P_base remains read-only.
5/4/3/1 credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are never capability truth or promotion authority.

Speedup is established only by sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover baselines using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, full assigned-workload coverage and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
decision_summary: New material objection: Experience-ledger ingestion is computationally unbounded because aggregate_experience_events accepts arbitrary Iterable input with no record/time/memory budget or resumable overflow semantics.

The ten owner-priority checks remain bounded-veto active where applicable: secretary freshness/authority, small-n anti-thrash, anti-thrash performance, progress-density feedback, replay/lineage, operational-only classification, verifier evidence binding, heuristic credits and statistically valid speedup measurement.
No formal/code mutation, no C PASS claim, v1 verified baseline preserved, P_base read-only.
